Prevents session-library accumulation stalls at the source."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Every session type has a defined destination: finished one-shot subagents are archived automatical"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ly, idle continuable subagents / main sessions are archived, and overflow is recycled by priority. *"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"*Archive first (recoverable), delete after expiry** — the GUI syncs within 30s, fully panel-configur"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"overable), delete after expiry** — the GUI syncs within 30s, fully panel-configured with hot reload."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"简体中文 · Apache-2.0 · npm · [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-pruner) · Changelog"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) caches a full projection of every session in `session_projcache.json` (token "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"stats, context pressure, ...), and the storage backend rewrites the whole file atomically on **every"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"** write. When the session library accumulates thousands of subagent sessions:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- The cache balloons past 100MB and each checkpoint fully re-serializes → main process CPU 250%+
- T"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"he single-threaded event loop is saturated → **every session load stalls, even `GET /` times out**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Managing session lifecycle (this plugin) is the root fix: no session accumulation → no cache rows → "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ession lifecycle (this plugin) is the root fix: no session accumulation → no cache rows → no stalls."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features: full-type lifecycle"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Session type | Trigger | Action | Default |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **one-shot subagent** | `subagent/end` / `agent/disposed` event (+ grace) | archive within seconds"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" (event-driven) | event + 3min grace |
| **continuable subagent** | idle over N days | archive (reco"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"verable) | off (0 days) |
| **main session** | idle over N days | archive (recoverable) | off (0 day"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s) |
| **any type** | total exceeds capacity cap | recycle by `one-shot → continuable → main` + olde"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"st | 400 |
| **archive directory** | kept over N hours | physically deleted | 24 hours |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> **Behavior note (v0.2.3+)**: one-shot subagents are archived uniformly by the `oneShotMinAgeMinute"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s` idle threshold (default 3 minutes), with or without end-seed. The earlier fallback — "one-shot se"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ssions without end-seed must stay idle a full hour before archiving" — has been removed."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Archive mechanism (recoverable)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Cleaned sessions are **moved to `~/.dsh/sessions-archive/`** first (workspace/session-id structure p"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"reserved) — they disappear from the GUI immediately (the list only reads the sessions directory), bu"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"t the files remain and can be restored manually:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"A "delete directly" mode (no archive, irreversible) is also available."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Safety (double protection)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Running sessions are never touched**: live sessions (still held in the in-memory session store, "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"open/loading) are skipped — and the live check is **fail-closed**: a store query error treats the se"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ssion as live, never deleting on uncertainty
- **Idle = last log write**: idle is judged by the sess"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ion log file mtime (last write time), not the directory mtime — DSH appends to `session.jsonl.zstd`,"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" so active sessions keep refreshing their mtime and are never misjudged idle
- **one-shot**: finishe"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"d one-shot subagents are archived uniformly by the `oneShotMinAgeMinutes` idle threshold (with or wi"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"thout end-seed, same threshold); the capacity cap additionally skips sessions lacking `session/end-s"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"eed`
- Main sessions do not participate in capacity recycling by default (configurable)
